notes.title: First!
notes.content:
We're alive!

Hey everyone!

We know it's been pretty quiet on this page over the past few months — thanks so much for your patience! Since launching the game's Steam page, we've been hard at work getting Leaforia to a place we're truly proud of.

We’ve got an important announcement coming in the next few days, so stay tuned.

We're also planning to start sharing more updates about the game's development here soon!
